scripts.build: vite build && tsc server.ts --outDir dist-server --esModuleInterop --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck
scripts.deploy:preview: gcloud run deploy karaoke-syncer-preview --source . --region us-west1 --allow-unauthenticated --set-secrets GEMINI_API_KEY=gemini-api-key:latest --memory 1Gi --timeout 300
scripts.deploy:preview:delete: gcloud run services delete karaoke-syncer-preview --region us-west1 --quiet
